What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/94d33dcb92ddb84479c1ea7b01d5619268a10786a19f318fba61f3107ba9b551.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(6,4).$
